radar.title: Your profile, axis by axis
radar.hint: Tap any axis to see what it measures and where the number comes from.
radar.prompt: Tap an axis on the chart to see how it was measured.
radar.measured: How it was measured: {{answered}} of your answers scored on this axis, and you gathered {{points}} of the {{max}} points available in them. The value above is that proportion on a 0 to 10 scale, so every axis can be compared even though they do not all have the same number of questions.
radar.notMeasured: How it was measured: none of the questions you answered scored on this axis. If you skipped a lot, this value says more about what you left blank than about you.

desc.ANALYTICAL: Taking a problem apart and seeing what causes it. It shows up in people who enjoy finding the pattern behind a pile of loose data.
desc.SCIENTIFIC: Asking why things happen and wanting to check it rather than assume it. The kind of curiosity that is not satisfied by the first explanation.
desc.TECHNICAL: Handling tools, systems and machines, and understanding how they work inside. That includes digital things, but not only those.
desc.PRACTICAL: Building with your hands and seeing the finished result. Preferring to make something real over talking about how it would be made.
desc.ENTREPRENEURIAL: Spotting an opportunity and starting without being asked. Coping well with the uncertainty of having no path already laid out.
desc.LEADERSHIP: Organising a group towards something and owning whether it lands. It is not bossing people: it is everyone knowing what to do and why.
desc.SOCIAL: Understanding people, listening and helping. You can tell by whether others come to you when they have a problem.
desc.CREATIVE: Imagining something that does not exist yet and giving it shape. It works in art as much as in engineering: proposing a way out nobody had seen.
